Investigating - We’re investigating an issue affecting help.dropbox.com. Customers may experience slower-than-usual page loads and search results when accessing Help Center content and self-service support resources.

Our teams are working to determine the cause and scope of the performance degradation. We’ll provide another update as more information becomes available.
